name: Janneke2: Job Matching Agent (chat friendly) review 2

traits.name: Reference
traits.description: Compare the correctness of the answer to the reference, given the query
traits.criteria:
The Agent's Answer conveys the same meaning as the Reference Answer.
Only semantic equivalence or near-equivalence is acceptable.
Any contradiction, significant omission, or added meaning results in outcome = false.
Do not judge correctness or quality beyond this comparison.

traits.name: Expectations
traits.criteria:
The Agent's execution (Answer and Trajectory combined) satisfies the defined Expectations.
Commute expectations can be expressed in hours or distance, both are acceptable.
